# Gantry

> An opinionated Go web framework with generated application code, shared templ layouts, Turbo and Stimulus, SQLite or Postgres, and built-in asset, image and caching features. Apps run and deploy through Houston. Gantry Strict helps apps adopt the framework's performance and development patterns.

## Building applications
- [Guide for agents](https://github.com/scttymn/gantry/blob/main/docs/agents.md): start here when building or maintaining a Gantry app; defaults, pinned tools, generators, Strict, verification and deployment
- [README](https://github.com/scttymn/gantry/blob/main/README.md): create an app, run it and find the framework packages
- [Development checks](https://github.com/scttymn/gantry/blob/main/docs/development.md): current checks and fixes, automatic browser panel, exceptions, timing and an editor example
- [Gantry Strict](https://github.com/scttymn/gantry/blob/main/docs/strict.md): purpose, rule registry, extensions and coverage limits

## Working on Gantry
- [Contributing](https://github.com/scttymn/gantry/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): framework tests, generator fixtures and adoption checks for new features
- [Releases](https://github.com/scttymn/gantry/releases): versioned CLI binaries and checksums; use the app's pinned version

## Deployment
- [Houston's guide for agents](https://github.com/scttymn/houston/blob/main/docs/agents.md): connect to the user's server, link an app, configure secrets and storage, and verify deployments

## Optional
- [Design plans](https://github.com/scttymn/gantry/tree/main/docs/plans): implementation history and measurements; confirm current behavior against the app's pinned version

- [Authentication](https://github.com/scttymn/gantry/blob/main/docs/auth.md): Email/password and email-code login, verified signup, delivery and shared limits.

- [Mail](https://github.com/scttymn/gantry/blob/main/docs/mail.md): Shared app mail configuration, SMTP delivery and the development inbox.
